```yaml
name: Fix Dependabot Security Vulnerabilities

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 * * 1' # Run every Monday at midnight UTC
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  fix-dependabot-vulnerabilities:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v3

      - name: Set up Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v3
        with:
          go-version: '1.19'

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v3
        with:
          node-version: '16'
          registry-url: 'https://registry.npmjs.org/'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          go mod tidy
          npm install --workspace=backend/services/bulkdata/http
          npm install --workspace=backend/services/utils/socketio
          npm install --workspace=frontend

      - name: Update dependencies
        run: |
          go get golang.org/x/crypto@0.45.0 golang.org/x/sys@0.38.0
          npm update --workspace=backend/services/bulkdata/http express@4.22.1
          npm update --workspace=backend/services/utils/socketio qs@^6.14.2 body-parser@^1.20.4
          npm update --workspace=frontend next@15.5.12 koa@3.0.3 js-yaml@4.1.1 eslint@8.57.1 eslint-config-next@15.5.12
          echo '{ "resolutions": { "qs": "^6.14.2", "body-parser": "^1.20.4" } }' > backend/services/utils/socketio/package.json.resolutions
          echo '{ "resolutions": { "eslint-plugin-import": "^2.26.0", "eslint-plugin-react": "^7.32.2", "eslint-plugin-react-hooks": "^4.6.0" } }' > frontend/package.json.resolutions

      - name: Verify dependencies
        run: |
          go list -m all | grep -E 'golang\.org/x/crypto|golang\.org/x/sys' && \
          npm ls --depth=0 --json | jq '.dependencies | keys[] as $key | select($key == "express" or $key == "qs" or $key == "body-parser") | .[$key].version' && \
          npm ls --depth=0 --json | jq '.dependencies | keys[] as $key | select($key == "next" or $key == "koa" or $key == "js-yaml" or $key == "eslint" or $key == "eslint-config-next") | .[$key].version'

      - name: Commit changes
        run: |
          git add .
          git commit -m "chore: fix Dependabot security vulnerabilities"
          git push origin main
```
